body: The user confirms for this review that work depending on the named legacy mechanisms is complete and the v2 mechanism is operational. The selected task is removal of superseded runtime support while preserving functioning v2 and untouched historical evidence. No migration, temporary continuation or permanent historical reader is planned. The earlier failed workflow-context query remains a failed historical observation and is not a prerequisite to accepting this owner-confirmed baseline. Any concrete contradictory residue discovered during removal requires a bounded owner disposition, not a speculative compatibility program. This records user-provided authority, not a new repository execution result or implementation approval.

decisions.rationale: Record the latest direct user confirmation as the operating baseline for proposal revision, attributed to the user rather than independently executed verification.
